explication: Gutenberg is the WordPress block-based editing and site-building project. The principal workflow is an author editing modular post content, with media processing and persistence through WordPress. Separate capabilities include site-wide theme styling and experimental real-time collaboration. The tree and README establish these product areas; sampled code supports the style-generation, global-styles REST, media-upload, and collaboration-storage roles, but does not establish every connection between editor screens and back-end services.
